verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI-based agent orchestrator with no evidence of any mobile app, phone notification, or remote approval interface; all workflows described (task start, merge land, ledger, benchmark) are CLI/Git-native and terminal-bound. There is no mention of phone-based or async human-approval UX for in-flight agent decisions. Missing for 10: any mobile/phone interface, push-notification or approval-request mechanism, remote decision-approval workflow.
